reviews.text:
Groomer in haarlemerstraat is very aggressive with dogs and rude.
Was very rude and impatient from the drop off moment, saw her being aggressive with another dog as well. Called our sensitive dog bad dog for being scared and charged us extra. Do not trust her

100% recommend! We went as first timers with our small puppy and didn’t know what to expect. Enrico made both us and our pup feel very at ease straight away! Lovely experience and we’ll definitely be back.
They were very friendly and Juno (the dog) was very happy with the result. Thank you and see you again soon!

Enrico and his team are simply exceptional. They look after our corgi, Hank (who is equal parts dog and gremlin!), with so much love, patience and genuine care every single time. You can tell they truly adore dogs, and Hank is always so happy to see them.

It’s incredibly hard to find a place in the city where people love and care for your dog as much as you do, but this is one of those rare places. Hank always comes home looking amazing, and we leave knowing he’s been treated like family. We couldn’t recommend Enrico and the team more highly.

We have brought our mixed breed here twice now and are beyond happy about EMG! Olivia is a rescue streetdog and the first time we took her here was her first experience with being groomed and the staff was very patient and careful with her. Same thing second time around, very sweet and calm even though the dog was a bit nervous. We will continue to bring Olivia here for grooming since the staff is friendly and knowledgeable, pricing is fair, communication is easy and the results are great. Thank you so much and see you next time!

We heard different great stories about this grooming studio in our neighbourhood. And wow we are so happy with te result. Lovely staff and they definitely know how to treat your dog very very well and made your dog feel comfortable even if she is afraid like our dog. The studio makes lovely videos in which you can see what they do and how they do it and most important you can see how your dog feels at that moment.

We are very very happy and can definitely recommend!

The team here took great care of Suki.

Shes is a bit of a diva (as are all husky’s).

But they took the time and fully adjusted to her needs.

She came out fresh, clean and with a bounce in her steps!

Thanks You!

Having a breed as extra as an American Cocker with super high-maintenance fur, I was recommended this grooming place and I can honestly say I’m beyond happy with it. They’re super kind, really loving with the dogs, helpful, and the final result is amazing. Thanks Enrico! Totally recommend!
Thank you for the 5 stars! We're so glad you had a great experience with us. See you next time!

If you are looking for a top-tier groomer, look no further. We have been following Enrico for years, even before he opened this beautiful location in Czaar Peterstraat, and the service remains consistently outstanding.
I take my Frenchie and Boston Terrier to EMG Dog Grooming for their spa days, and the team’s expertise is second to none. They use high-quality, specific products tailored to each dog's needs, which has been a game-changer for my Boston Terrier who suffers from seasonal allergies. Enrico and his team helped us tremendously by setting up a dedicated treatment plan with weekly spa cycles that have visibly improved his skin and coat health.
Beyond the treatments, they are always friendly, available, and offer professional advice on how to maintain their coats at home. It’s rare to find such high-level expertise combined with genuine care. Highly recommended!"
